{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Correct the population: only include converted orders that are not refunded
# Because 'converted' == 1 does not imply 'completed and not refunded'
converted_and_completed = sales[(sales['converted'] == 1) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Now compute mean age of this group
mean_age = converted_and_completed['customer_age'].mean()

# Check for -1 values in this group
missing_age_count = (converted_and_completed['customer_age'] == -1).sum()

print(f"Number of converted and completed orders: {len(converted_and_completed)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted and completed customers: {mean_age}")
print(f"Number of -1 values in this group: {missing_age_count}")"}
